about.heading: About Me
about.paragraph1: I am Paula Sevarolli, stylist and fashion designer, with a deep passion for creativity, fashion, and aesthetics. As a Brazilian with Italian roots, I have lived in Brazil, Italy, Germany, and the Czech Republic. These experiences have deeply shaped my perspective on style, culture, and individuality.
about.paragraph2: I completed my Master’s degree in Fashion Design at IED in Florence, Italy, and further specialized as a style consultant. Over the years, I gained experience across various areas of the fashion industry. This combination of education, practical experience, and personal growth defines my work today.
about.paragraph3: As a mother and a woman who has personally experienced different phases of life, body changes, and cultural transitions, I know how closely style is tied to one's sense of well-being – and how challenging it can be to redefine oneself at certain moments.
about.paragraph4: I work with people going through these exact transitions: after pregnancy, when stepping into a new professional role, or adjusting to a new culture. My approach is intentionally personal and grounded in real life – free from rigid rules or short-lived trends.
about.paragraph5: I view fashion as a subtle yet powerful form of self-expression. A harmonious style doesn't stem from perfection, but from clarity, self-knowledge, and feeling comfortable in your own skin. With my trained eye for colors, cuts, shapes, and proportions, I help you develop an authentic style that truly fits your everyday life. It is not about following trends, but about knowing yourself better and projecting that expression outward.
about.paragraph6: Whether it is a Wardrobe Reset, Personal Shopping, Color Analysis, or Individual Style Consulting – I accompany you on your journey toward greater clarity, confidence, and ease in your personal style.
about.paragraph7: Because true style begins where you recognize yourself.

reviewsPage.title: Reviews
reviewsPage.headline: Voices that speak for themselves
reviewsPage.message: Every consultation is unique – here clients share how their journey toward a more cohesive, confident style felt.

reviews.text: “When I started my law firm, I realized that my image could help me convey value even before I had the chance to talk about my work. The consulting firm helped me find a balance between the formality of the legal profession and my own personality, so that I could convey professionalism while still feeling comfortable in what I wore. Paula knew how to build a strategy based on who I was and the message I wanted to convey, rather than simply following trends. More than just learning about colors, pieces, or combinations, I learned to recognize the implicit messages behind each choice and to use them intentionally. It was a process that transformed not only how people perceived me, but also how I saw myself—and it’s a lesson I carry with me to this day.”
reviews.author: Deise Cordeiro

reviews.text: “The advice Paula gave my then-husband was extremely important. Thanks to her, we were able to help him understand that a laid-back, casual style has its time and place. Over time, we were able to invest in timeless pieces that elevated the end client’s sense of style and elegance.”
reviews.author: Natany Gomes

wardrobeReset.title: Wardrobe Reset
wardrobeReset.intro: Together we organize your wardrobe and create clarity. You keep only what truly fits your current life, your style, and your body – everything else can go. For greater lightness and order in your daily routine.
wardrobeReset.listItem1: sorting by color, shape, and function
wardrobeReset.detailIntro: For anyone seeking more clarity, organization, and lightness in their wardrobe.
wardrobeReset.detailText1: Perhaps you know the feeling: your wardrobe is full, yet you feel like you have nothing to wear. Between clothes you haven't worn in a long time, impulse buys, pieces you 'might need someday', and old favorites, it's easy to lose sight of what you actually have.
wardrobeReset.detailText2: That is exactly where we start together. We look through your wardrobe item by item and decide honestly and without pressure which pieces stay, which can be altered or recombined, and which you wish to say goodbye to.
wardrobeReset.detailText3: In doing so, we consider not only your taste, but above all your present life, daily routine, body, and personal style.
wardrobeReset.detailText4: Together we explore how your wardrobe can be optimized to find the right proportions between tops and bottoms, reorganizing it so that all items are visible and practical for everyday use.
wardrobeReset.detailListLabel: We ask ourselves questions such as:
wardrobeReset.detailList1: What do you truly love to wear regularly?
wardrobeReset.detailList2: Which garments fit into your current lifestyle?
wardrobeReset.detailList3: What flatters you and makes you feel comfortable?
wardrobeReset.detailList4: Which pieces can be combined with one another?
wardrobeReset.detailList5: Where might essential basics be missing?
wardrobeReset.detailList6: Which garments are hanging in the closet simply because you hesitate to let go?
wardrobeReset.detailText5: You receive an honest, supportive external perspective. It's about purchasing more consciously and simplifying your morning routine. In the end, your wardrobe will be clearer, more cohesive, and above all, practical for daily life.

colorConsultation.title: Color Analysis
colorConsultation.intro: We discover your unique colors that make you look fresh, vibrant, and authentic. You learn which shades highlight your natural features – for confidence when shopping and coordinating outfits.
colorConsultation.listItem1: greater confidence when shopping and combining items
colorConsultation.listItem2: a clearer vision of your personal color palette
colorConsultation.detailIntro: Discover the colors that highlight your natural radiance.
colorConsultation.detailText1: Color is one of the most impactful elements of our look and appearance. We are all born with a unique personal color combination: skin tone, hair color, lashes, eyebrows, lip color, and more. The colors we choose for our clothes, makeup, accessories, and hair should harmonize with these natural traits.
colorConsultation.detailText2: The right shades make your skin look smoother, enhance your eye color, and give you a refreshed, youthful appearance. Conversely, unsuitable colors can make you look pale, accentuate dark circles, and give a tired appearance.
colorConsultation.detailText3: During a personal color analysis, we determine color characteristics regarding temperature (cool or warm), contrast (high, medium, or low), and intensity (vibrant or muted). With this information, we identify the color palette that harmonizes best with you.
colorConsultation.detailText4: At the end of the session, you will receive your personal 12-season color palette in print. It serves as a practical guide for shopping and assembling your outfits.
colorConsultation.detailListLabel: Your individual palette includes recommendations for:
colorConsultation.detailText5: This keeps your essential colors at hand so you can quickly identify which shades flatter you most while shopping. Color analysis doesn't set rigid rules. Instead, you learn to select your colors intentionally, combine them, and understand where they make the biggest difference in your look.

personalShopping.title: Personal Shopper & Styling
personalShopping.intro: Together we targetedly find clothes that truly suit you – replacing frustration and bad buys. You receive honest, stylish guidance while shopping, tailored to your lifestyle, body shape, and personal taste.
personalShopping.listItem1: a targeted selection tailored to your daily life
personalShopping.listItem2: stylish tips for combinations and shopping confidence
personalShopping.detailIntro: Shop with intent, instead of spending hours searching only to leave empty-handed.
personalShopping.detailText1: Shopping can be fun – but it can also be exhausting and frustrating. Endless choices, varying cuts, changing trends, and the question 'Does this really suit me?' often make it hard to make the right decisions.
personalShopping.detailText2: During Personal Shopping, I accompany you in person to help you find clothes that genuinely fit you. Before shopping, we review what you need and what fits your daily routine, taking into account your personal style, body shape, wishes, and budget.
personalShopping.detailText3: Shopping isn't about buying as much as possible. On the contrary: it's about buying mindfully and looking for key pieces that elevate your wardrobe and combine seamlessly.
personalShopping.detailText4: I will show you how to identify quality fabrics and craftsmanship, and how to discern where an investment is worthwhile and where it's better to save.
personalShopping.detailListLabel: I will show you, for example:
personalShopping.detailList1: which cuts harmoniously balance your proportions,
personalShopping.detailList2: which fabrics and silhouettes suit you best,
personalShopping.detailList4: and which items you might want to avoid.
personalShopping.detailText5: You don't need to change who you are or force yourself into trends just because they are popular. Your style should serve you – not the other way around. The goal is a wardrobe in which you feel comfortable, that fits your life, and gives you effortless outfit options.

individualConsultation.title: Individual Style Consulting
individualConsultation.intro: We develop your personal style based on your personality, lifestyle, and body shape. You gain clarity on what makes you unique – and how to make that visible through your wardrobe.
individualConsultation.listItem2: a clear strategy for your daily life and wardrobe
individualConsultation.detailIntro: Our personal appearance is – even when we don't realize it – an important form of communication.
individualConsultation.detailText1: Before we say a single word, our appearance conveys messages and influences how we are perceived – in terms of credibility, professionalism, personality, approachability, authority, and even lifestyle.
individualConsultation.detailText2: However, dressing well goes far beyond following trends or selecting nice clothes. Often, the image we project does not reflect who we truly are, does not align with our personality, or simply doesn't fit our current daily life and stage of life. That is where style gains meaning: it must make sense for you, be practical and functional, while simultaneously reflecting your identity.
individualConsultation.detailText3: Developing a style concept is therefore a journey of self-discovery and analysis. It is about understanding who you are, your preferences, needs, goals, and priorities, what your daily life looks like, and translating that into a cohesive, authentic, and strategic image.
individualConsultation.detailText4: The goal of the consultation is to create clarity and independence, so that by the end of the process you not only know what to wear, but also why certain choices work for you.
individualConsultation.detailList1: develop a clearer understanding of the image you wish to project,
individualConsultation.detailList2: discover the colors that bring out your natural beauty,
individualConsultation.detailList3: learn to select cuts and fits suited to your body shape,
individualConsultation.detailList4: build a more cohesive, versatile, and functional wardrobe,
individualConsultation.detailList5: acquire tools for more conscious and confident shopping.
individualConsultation.detailText5: Individual style consulting is a comprehensive and personalized process that encompasses all necessary steps to implement this concept consistently, such as personal color analysis, wardrobe audit, and personal shopping.
individualConsultation.detailText6: Based on everything we uncover throughout the process, we create an exclusive style concept tailored to you, taking into account your personality, routine, goals, and preferences. We define the cuts, fits, fabrics, materials, colors, patterns, proportions, and details that best reflect who you are and elevate your image.
individualConsultation.detailText7: Style consulting aims not only to transform your wardrobe, but above all your relationship with it: dressing more consciously, confidently, and effortlessly so that your appearance truly aligns with who you are.
